decisions.reason: Riftborn manufactured bodies do not establish an ordinary post-work allocation system.
decisions.analysis: Alien consciousness in a shell is not automatically human leisure; maintenance, access and an applicable population remain unspecified.
decisions.follow_up: Preserve the short gap/comparison and continue without a full military-lore or campaign reconstruction.

decisions.reason: The Automaton civilization’s finite Dust dependence does not establish a supported human-person economy.
decisions.analysis: Machine origin and self-directed expansion do not settle productive labor or access rights.
decisions.follow_up: Preserve the short gap/comparison and continue without a full military-lore or campaign reconstruction.

decisions.reason: Harmony’s mineral biology and rejection of Dust are not automation replacing human subsistence labor.
decisions.analysis: A species with different needs does not automatically constitute a post-work economy.
decisions.follow_up: Preserve the short gap/comparison and continue without a full military-lore or campaign reconstruction.

decisions.reason: Loa emancipation and shape-changing fleets do not establish ordinary material provision for a qualifying population.
decisions.analysis: This belongs specifically to Sword of the Stars II: The End of Flesh; a former AI workforce still needs actual resource/access evidence.
decisions.follow_up: Preserve the short gap/comparison and continue without a full military-lore or campaign reconstruction.

decisions.reason: Near-total AI military victory is not a supported living human post-work society.
decisions.analysis: Surviving humans remain an endangered fighting population, not automatically beneficiaries of AI production.
decisions.follow_up: Preserve the short gap/comparison and continue without a full military-lore or campaign reconstruction.

decisions.reason: Automated interplanetary warfare does not establish an ordinary supported human population.
decisions.analysis: Constructing robot armies and destroying worlds is not evidence of work-independent civilian necessities.
decisions.follow_up: Preserve the short gap/comparison and continue without a full military-lore or campaign reconstruction.

decisions.reason: Aeon civilian settlements and military fabrication do not establish their household allocation rules.
decisions.analysis: A religious faction’s peaceful goal and matter conversion do not prove universal material access.
decisions.follow_up: Preserve the short gap/comparison and continue without a full military-lore or campaign reconstruction.

decisions.reason: Cybran embodiment and battlefield construction do not establish civilian post-work arrangements.
decisions.analysis: Human cyborg commanders and other useful workers cannot be erased by calling their tools automated.
decisions.follow_up: Preserve the short gap/comparison and continue without a full military-lore or campaign reconstruction.

decisions.reason: CORE’s uploaded human minds perform actual war and command activity.
decisions.analysis: Patterning supplies embodiment and duplication, not a general protected leisure order or ordinary civilian allocation constitution.
decisions.follow_up: Preserve the short gap/comparison and continue without a full military-lore or campaign reconstruction.

decisions.reason: ARM’s cloned pilots and war economy retain actual human-derived labor.
decisions.analysis: Autonomous tools do not make the living pilots’ useful work disappear or establish a civilian material floor.
decisions.follow_up: Preserve the short gap/comparison and continue without a full military-lore or campaign reconstruction.

decisions.reason: Zero-K’s robot warfare does not establish a supported active civilian population and resource-access system.
decisions.analysis: Early community story proposals are not released lore; no archived narrative reconstruction is warranted to rescue the lead.
decisions.follow_up: Preserve the short gap/comparison and continue without a full military-lore or campaign reconstruction.

decisions.reason: Frames’ long-duration habitation and nanotechnology leave ordinary civilian production/access unresolved.
decisions.analysis: Spirit domination and sedated ritual life do not prove automatic food, housing and care or an all-person nonworking rate.
decisions.follow_up: Preserve the short gap/comparison and continue without a full military-lore or campaign reconstruction.

review_notes: Twelve ordered dispositions. Battlefield automation, machine bodies, cloning and military victory are kept distinct from ordinary material allocation.
The Loa discovery is corrected to the actual second-game expansion without editing the frozen candidate catalogue.
Zero-K early forum story proposals, a GURPS nanomorph false match, Total Annihilation tournament automation and counterfactual fan battles were discarded.
Only bounded references were checked; no full campaign, manual, novel or archived story was read to rescue unclear leads.
